description: Add stage-aware guidance for transform-before-place and two-object placement loops.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb['stage'] = 'find_target'
    nb['last_hint'] = ''
    nb['transformed'] = False
    nb['placed_count'] = 0
    nb['placed_locations'] = []
    text = 'Follow ALFWorld order: find and take the target, do any required clean/heat/cool while carrying it, then put it at the destination. For two-object tasks, leave placed items and fetch another target for the same destination.'
    return {'skills': [{'text': text}], 'tool_hint': 'Do not place a transformable target before the required transform; do not take back an item already placed for a two-object task.'}
